title: Concept: Composer requirement allowed to float within a line
description: composer.json declares a `~` requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `~` requirement.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `~` requirement.
